tei:div.tei:p: blo sbyong sems dpa'i rim pa las zlog phyogs gnyen po'i chos bzhugs so/ /snying rje'i gdung ba sman gcig pu/ /bdag lta 'thul ba'i gnyen gcig po/ /chags sdang skyob pa'i lha gcig po/ /gnyen pos rtsa ba chod la 'dud/ /nyon mongs rnam rtog skyes pa'i tshe/ /rgya khras byi'u ded pa ltar/ /dmigs su bskor la bkar ded gyis/ /lag tu zin de brlag par gyis/ /ngan rtog snying la zhen pa'i tshe/ /dgra rkun ngos 'dzin byed pa ltar/ /dbyibs dang spu ris phye mdzod la/ /phyin chad rtog pa med par gyis/ /bzang rtog dgra ru langs pa'i tshe/ /gshed ma bur brdzus zin pa ltar/ /zin ma thag tu mgo mnon la/ /srog gcod rtog pa med par gyis/ /skyid 'dod le lo byung ba'i tshe/ /ston g.yog gnyid log blangs pa ltar/ /bsdad pa'i skabs med drag 'chun gyis/ /rnam grol las la bzla bar bya/ /tshe 'di'i che thabs bsgrub pa'i tshe/ /srin po mi bza' mthong ba ltar/ /ldang zhing las de'i 'phro bzhag la/ /mi pham las las rgyang ring bros/ /zla dang g.yeng bas khyer ba'i tshe/ /g.yul ngor mi ro mthong ba ltar/ /grogs dang bcas la rab sdang zhing / /dben pa'i nags khrod bsten par bya/ /chags sdang bdud kyis g.yengs pa'i tshe/ /khyi smyon dug sbrul mthong ba ltar/ /'khor ba'i bde la rgyab phyogs kyis/ /btsan sa myang 'das dbyings su bros/ /rtag 'dzin btson rar bsdams pa'i tshe/ /rgyal pos dong du mnar ba ltar/ /nam 'chi cha med rab bsams la/ /yid 'byung skyo shas drag po bsten/ /thos bsam lo 'dod shor ba'i tshe/ /zlos gar mkhan gyis bshad pa ltar/ /lag len med par rab bsams nas/ /rang la khrel brdas chen po bya/ /nyin mtshan chos la 'bad gyur kyang / /da dung skya dri ma yal na/ /bdud kyis khyer bar rab bsams la/ /bzlog ste gnyen po bsten par bya/ /byas pa chos la bsams gyur kyang / /ci byas log par song gyur na/ /'gong pos khyer bar rab bsams la/

/nges par dkon mchog ra mdar sbran/ /bla ma'i grwa sar bsdad gyur kyang / /mkhan slob grogs po ltar bcos pa'i/ /chos la chags sdang gos gyur na/ /bdud las bsams la nags khrod bsten/ /rtse gcig sgom sgrub byas gyur kyang / /da dung grol bya ma rnyed na/ /thos pas gol sa ma rnyed skyon/ /bsams la mdo sde zab mo lta/ /blo sbyong sems dpa'i rim pa las zlog phyogs gnyen po'i chos rnams yongs su rdzogs so// PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 blo sbyong sems dpa'i rim pa las zlog phyogs gnyen po'i chos/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
